notes: Only the Donald Duck booklet (pages 1-33, set 40377) was recorded; the Pluto/Goofy cover on page 34 and the parts list page for set 40378 were ignored. The inventory used is the Donald Duck parts list supplied (90 pieces).
Piece counts match the parts list per type/colour: LBG 22885 x13 (b15,b17,b33-37,b43-48), tan 22885 x1 (b38), 3023 white x5/blue x2/orange x5, 87079 white x6 + black x1, 3710 white x3 + blue x1, etc.

Body is built in a rotated orientation in the booklet; ids follow booklet page order. The two orange 1x2 plate stacks (b73-b76) and the two wedge feet (b77, b78) are added late (steps 24-25) but sit under the lowest corner plates b3/b4, so b3/b4 list the top plate of each leg stack in rests_on, and the wedges rest on the 92593 plate (b90) of the base.

Exact stud footprints of the first layers (bracket, corner plates b3-b6, 1x4 and 2x4 white plates b12/b13, front plate b27) are hard to read from the small isometric drawings; rests_on there is a best-effort reading.

Head: ring 1 (b33-b38) has side columns of two 1x2 bricks per side and the tan brick in the front middle, ring 2 (b43-b48) has front/back pairs and one middle brick per side. Face plate b52 and back plate b68 and side tiles are attached to the studs on the side faces of these bricks (listed as other_joins).

Two curved bricks 15068 (b82, b83) are assumed stacked in the hat (catalogue gives it studs); the tile b84 and slope b86 sit on the plate ends; handle plate b85 hangs from the clip plate b81 via clip/bar.
Base (step 29): 6x6 black plate with 2x4 tile, 1x4 tile and 2-stud 1x4 plate; the feet (wedges) stand on the two studs of b90. position is null throughout as required.
